title: driver / driver.profile_updated (v1) data payload
description: Driver's racing profile (identity/preference fields) for a masterId changed, or was created for the first time via the minimal-profile safety net. Published to the 'driver.events' exchange with routing key 'driver.profile_updated'. Field names/types mirror the 'racing' branch of contract/schemas/frontend/profile.edit_requested.v1.schema.json exactly (Q&A Round 35/Q35.1). Carries no PR/history stats — those are driver.pr_updated and driver.history_appended's own concern (Stories 3.4/3.3), never duplicated here.

masterId.description: Canonical masterId issued by Identity. Lowercase canonical UUID v4 (version nibble 4, variant nibble [89ab]); the pattern is enforced (format is annotation-only).

racingNumber.description: Preferred racing number. Null until set; always present (no omitempty on a meaningful wire field, AR9).

kartClass.description: Preferred kart class. Null until set.

nickname.description: Leaderboard nickname. Null until set — Leaderboard falls back to racing number / a short masterId until this arrives (FR46).
